title: AI cloud startup Verda raises $189m in Series B funding round
source_used: SiliconANGLE of 22 Sep 2026 (https://siliconangle.com/2026/09/22/european-neocloud-verda-raises-189m-to-build-the-ai-infrastructure-of-tomorrow/), read in full. The Data Center Dynamics page (the pool item) could not be opened (HTTP 403).
key_facts: Verda Cloud Oy, a Helsinki, Finland company formerly known as DataCrunch, announced on 22 Sep 2026 that it raised $189 million in a Series B round led by Emergence Capital (SiliconANGLE).
Other investors include MUFG Innovation Partners, Supermicro, Varma Mutual Pension Insurance, Lifeline Ventures, 6 Degrees Capital, byFounders and Tesi, plus angel investors.
The funding brings the company's total raised to more than $450 million in equity and debt.
Verda offers managed AI inference to enterprise customers and builds its own compilers and serving software; customers include Aleph Alpha and Magnific.

It plans to operate more than 250 megawatts in 2027, with capacity live in Finland and more coming across Europe, the UK, the US and Asia, and expects early deployments of Nvidia VR200 NVL72 racks in the coming months.
Bloomberg also reported the round on 22 Sep 2026 and ArcticStartup on 24 Sep 2026 (Google News listings); the Data Center Dynamics item dated 5 Oct 2026 in the pool carries the same headline.
quote_evidence: Helsinki, Finland-based neocloud outfit Verda Cloud Oy, formerly DataCrunch, today announced it has raised $189 million in early-stage funding to expand its artificial intelligence cloud infrastructure, from AI compute capacity to platform services.

Emergence Capital led the Series B round, with additional investments from MUFG Innovation Partners, Supermicro, Varma Mutual Pension Insurance Co., Lifeline Ventures, 6 Degrees Capital, byFounders and Tesi.
The funding brings the company’s total raised to more than $450 million in equity and debt.
